title: Nvidia to provide up to $105 billion financing for OpenAI Ohio data center
summary: Nvidia agreed to guarantee up to $105 billion in lease and power payments for OpenAI's massive AI data center campus in Ohio, securing up to 8 gigawatts of computing capacity with the first 800 megawatts expected online by 2028.
popularity_basis: Major deal between two AI industry leaders with unprecedented financial commitment, covered by CNBC, Bloomberg, Axios, and FT.

title: Anthropic reports $11.5 billion Q2 revenue, 14-fold year-over-year growth

popularity_basis: Extraordinary growth figures from major AI lab, widely covered by CNBC, Axios, Forbes, and Bloomberg ahead of anticipated IPO.

title: Berkshire Hathaway adds $17 billion to Alphabet stake in Q2
